channel.title: Imadlab Blog
channel.description: Technical notes on industrial AI systems, procedural extraction, architecture, and evaluation.

item.title: Evaluation Beyond Accuracy: Constraint Coverage and Safety in Procedure Extraction
item.description: Why standard NLP accuracy numbers are not enough for industrial procedure extraction, and what to measure instead.

item.title: Designing Local LLM Pipelines for Industrial Documentation
item.description: How I build local document intelligence pipelines when the data cannot leave the organization and every output has to be traceable.

item.title: Procedural Knowledge Extraction Is Not Summarization
item.description: In industrial documentation, a fluent summary can still be operationally wrong. Procedural extraction needs explicit structure and traceable validation, not better compression.

item.title: I Built a 10M-Parameter Language Model on My MacBook
item.description: I spent two weeks reading papers and two days training a 10M-parameter transformer on an M4 MacBook Pro. The first run went to NaN, and the third version writes coherent paragraphs but still cannot do math.
